name: Root Hall

objects.text: Roots through every stone. They hum, faintly. PATCH says that's normal.
More roots. They lean toward you when you walk past.
A CRT stone, awake now: a slow blue pulse, in time with the hills outside.
A keeper's mark carved under the screen: a hand, and a seal.
